description: The woman wears a fully opaque burgundy-red floor-length gown over a cream high-collared underdress. The cream collar closes high at the neck, and long cream cuffs reach her wrists below the full burgundy sleeves. Gold floral woven borders decorate the central front, sleeve edges and closed skirt hem. A dark blue mantle covers the shoulders and hangs down both sides, secured by two small round brooches linked with a short chain. A decorated leather belt has a round gold buckle and small fittings. Only face and hands are exposed; dark leather shoes appear beneath the hem.
